# Imposia 0.8.0

Imposia 0.8.0 lets tables with merged rows cross page boundaries and makes the
standalone HTML export hold its line breaks in a lower-resolution renderer. Both
additions are opt-in; every default is unchanged, so there are no breaking
changes.

## Highlights

- **Rowspan tables split between rows.** `tableRowspan: "split"` cuts a rowspan
  cluster at a page boundary instead of moving it whole. Merged cells keep their
  content once in the first piece and continue as empty cells of the remaining
  height, placed by logical column. A merged cell with its own
  `break-inside: avoid` keeps its cluster whole, and an unplaceable first row is
  kept together with `UNSUPPORTED_LAYOUT` and `PAGE_OVERFLOW`. The default is
  `"preserve"`; any other value throws a `TypeError`.
- **No needless page jump.** In `"split"` mode a plain container (`div`,
  `ol > li`) around a splittable table is fragmented in place, so the table
  starts in the space left on the page.
- **Widths carried across pages.** In `"split"` mode the table and its columns
  are measured before rows are taken out and the widths follow the table to
  every page, for collapsed and separate borders alike. A plain `colgroup` keeps
  its classes and backgrounds; other structures are left as authored.
- **Safe on hostile input.** Span handling is bounded (`colspan` is clamped like
  browsers do), and long splits yield to the scheduler and can be cancelled.
- **Pixel-ratio border correction for HTML export.**
  `exportPageDocumentHtml(document, { targetDevicePixelRatio })` widens the
  `td`/`th` borders a lower-ratio renderer would round up and takes the room
  back from the padding, in the exported copy only. Edges shared by cells of
  different widths in a collapsed table are left as authored.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/EungyuCho/imposia/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
